headline: Global AI Spend Forecast: $2.52T in 2026 (+44% YoY)
summary: Gartner reports global AI spending will hit $2.52 trillion in 2026, driven by a 44% year-over-year increase. Despite a 'Trough of Disillusionment' sentiment, infrastructure and service allocations remain at record highs.

headline: H100 Secondary Market Stabilizes at $20k-$35k Range
summary: Secondary market prices for Nvidia H100 (80GB) units have dropped ~45% from 2024 peaks, stabilizing as B200 supply enters the market. Cloud spot rates have hit a record low of $1.25/hr.

headline: Anthropic, Blackstone, Goldman Launch $1.5B Industrial AI JV
summary: A new joint venture aimed at 'Industrial AI scaling' focuses on hardware-software co-optimization for 100GW clusters, positioning AI as the 'McKinsey of Industrial Engineering.'

headline: AI API Price Wars: Gemini 3.1 Pro Leads at $2.00/MTok
summary: New generation flagship pricing has settled with Google leading on price. GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.6 are priced at $5.00/MTok input, reflecting a 2.5x premium for frontier reasoning.

headline: March 2026: 15,341 Jobs Directly Displaced by AI
summary: For the first time in history, 'AI-driven restructuring' was the leading cause of job cuts in the US, accounting for 25% of all layoffs in March 2026. Junior developer roles saw a 20% YoY decline.

unique_fields.data_point: 15,341 layoffs (25% of total); 20% decline in junior postings

headline: Healthcare GenAI Budgets Projected to Triple by 2026
summary: Industry-specific rotation is accelerating. Healthcare is leading the shift from administrative pilots to clinical data integration, with 38.6% of orgs now having dedicated GenAI budgets.

unique_fields.data_point: 3x growth in GenAI healthcare spend; 38.6% with dedicated budgets
